steps.title: What should an open scientific paper look like in the AI age?

features.text: You can dig deeper into any part of the methods
You can explore the raw data
You can replicate and remix it with a prompt

body: This is demonstration project, built on a paper we wrote (that is still under review).
We think all scientific papers should have these features. We built this site to inspire others to copy and improve it, and to do more open source science.

steps.title: Read the paper. Interactive exhibits give you more detail than you can fit onto a dead tree.
Explore placeholder submission pages; obtain permission before publishing real correspondence.
Explore a five-row illustrative data subset, including source evidence
Explore different specifications, intermediate data construction steps, and data exploration
Download the code and data, or just point an LLM at our site and ask some questions.
body: This site and the download packet have LLM instructions that give them everything they need to dive right into the analysis.
